title: Smooth duality: the gradient integral of a C² function over a compact set is bounded by its dual bound
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let w : ℝⁿ → ℝ be of class C², O ⊆ ℝⁿ open, L ⊆ O compact and M ∈ [0,∞]. Write Dw = fderiv ℝ w. Suppose ofReal(−∫ Dw(x)[g(x)] dx) ≤ M for every C¹ vector field g : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ O and ‖g(x)‖ ≤ 1 for all x. Then ∫⁻_L ‖Dw(x)‖ dx ≤ M, where ‖·‖ is the operator norm and the integral is the [0,∞]-valued lower integral of the extended norm.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : Rn n → ℝ) (O L : Set (Rn n)) (M : ℝ≥0∞), ContDiff ℝ 2 w → IsOpen O → IsCompact L → L ⊆ O → (∀ g : Rn n → Rn n, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ O → (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1) → ENNReal.ofReal (-∫ x, fderiv ℝ w x (g x)) ≤ M) → ∫⁻ x in L, ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ₑ ≤ M
